_comment: Source and toolchain lock for the WebAssembly engine build (PLAN P00.3, P00.4). scripts/bootstrap-engine.sh and scripts/build-engine.sh read this file; nothing retypes these values. Releases build from upstream.commit, never from a moving branch HEAD.

expected._comment: Cross-checked by scripts/engine-manifest.mjs against the checkout. A mismatch means the lock and the tree disagree; fix the lock deliberately, do not silently accept the tree.

emsdk.note: emsdk needs Python >= 3.10. macOS ships 3.9.6 first on PATH, so EMSDK_PYTHON must be exported for install/activate. emcc itself does not need it afterwards.

verifiedOn._comment: Versions this baseline was actually produced with (2026-09-13, macOS arm64). Minimums above are the supported floor; these are the observed ones.
